cover.concept: Two large overlapping translucent circles on a calm pale field, one deep indigo and one warm orange, sharing a soft overlapping lens in the middle; a single narrow pale doorway shape stands at the edge and opens only into the indigo circle, leaving the orange circle with no way in.

inline.name: second-door
inline.concept: Two identical narrow geometric doorway outlines standing side by side on a pale field; the left one glows a steady indigo, the right one has just swung open and a soft orange light spills out across the floor, quiet and welcoming.

inline.name: query-count
inline.concept: A long, even horizontal row of small muted-indigo dots on a pale field, with a short cluster of warm orange dots beginning to gather at one end, as if a second current has just started flowing into the line.
